native.ua_review_profile: Source identified UART hardware or independently qualified implementation.
native.ua_proposal_mode: Register reset proposals are not confirmed active device configuration.
native.ua_mode: Actual asynchronous start/stop versus independently qualified synchronous USART or extension.
native.ua_direction: Actual independent Tx/Rx or bound half-duplex direction.
native.ua_parity: Actual parity, stick parity only source supported hardware.
native.ua_peer_parity: Actual remote framing selection, separately verified.
native.ua_bit_order: Actual serialized data order. Reviewed UART profiles LSB first.
native.ua_flow: Actual CTS/RTS or software blocking, not assumed unlimited bandwidth.
native.ua_autobaud: Actual disabled/armed/complete/failed measurement; examples are not active baud.
native.ua_polarity: Actual TTL-side idle polarity, not RS232 external voltage sign.
native.ua_baud: Actual wire symbols/s; binary UART one bit/symbol, no universally mandated baud.
native.ua_peer_baud: Actual remote wire symbols/s, distinct oscillator/divider.
native.ua_target_baud: Actual commissioned target baud for divider error calculation.
native.ua_clock_hz: Actual PIC FCY=FOSC/2 or LPC PCLK input, not CPU oscillator substituted.
native.ua_oversampling: Actual PIC16 or4 sampling divider; LPC fixed16.
native.ua_brg: Actual PIC24H 16-bit UxBRG; zero legal max rate, not0baud.
native.ua_port: Actual selected UART0/1/2/3, hardware CTS/RTS only UART1 LPC24xx.
native.ua_data_bits: Actual payload data bits; parity not included here.
native.ua_start_bits: Actual occupied start periods, reviewed hardware1.
native.ua_stop_bits: Actual occupied stop periods; LPC5-bit long stop1.5, otherwise2.
native.ua_parity_bits: Actual parity overhead0none/1enabled, not another data bit.
native.ua_characters: Actual encoded character count, not arbitrary API write chunk octets.
native.ua_wire_bits: Actual encoded characters times occupied character periods.
native.ua_serialization_us: Actual wire bit-periods / actual baud, excluding idle and blocked flow.
native.ua_flow_block_us: Actual bounded CTS/software flow stalls; unbounded peer has no guaranteed completion.
native.ua_transfer_us: Actual complete serial transfer bound including gaps and blocking.
native.ua_rx_fifo: Actual available receive characters PIC4/LPC16, not software buffer bytes.
native.ua_tx_fifo: Actual available transmit FIFO characters excluding shift register.
native.ua_rx_occupancy: Actual unread hardware FIFO characters at observation.
native.ua_arrival_characters: Actual additional chars arriving before service.
native.ua_service_capacity: Actual chars removed during service envelope.
native.ua_post_occupancy: Actual post-service FIFO occupancy for specified ordering, not universal schedulability.
native.ua_peer_error_percent: Actual bounded oscillator+divider deviation magnitude of peer.
native.ua_local_error_percent: Actual bounded local oscillator+divider deviation magnitude.
native.ua_combined_error_percent: Actual sum of worst magnitudes under qualified independent error model.
native.ua_receiver_tolerance_percent: Actual device/mode-dependent verified receive sampling tolerance.
native.ua_autobaud_sync: Actual sync character PIC55h versus LPC AT A/a protocol.
native.ua_path_ms: Actual PHY/transfer and driver delivery bound.
native.ua_age_ms: Actual correlated data age at use.
native.ua_enabled: Actual UART and transmitter enabled; reset disabled is not productive interface.
native.ua_rx_enabled: Actual receiver active, separately from Tx.
native.ua_peer_verified: Actual matching baud/framing/polarity/flow and decoder on both endpoints.
native.ua_fifo_verified: Actual worst FIFO service/interrupt/DMA capacity and no lost chars.
native.ua_phy_verified: Actual electrical driver/voltage/cable/termination/ground and direction path.
native.ua_data_accepted: Actual fresh decoded dataset consumed under independent requirement.
native.ua_clock_source: Actual input-clock selection, oscillator and baud-divider register proof.
native.ua_phy_source: Actual TTL/RS232/RS422/RS485/bridge electrical binding, no UART electrical universal.
native.ua_codec_source: Actual application encoding/boundaries/escaping/endianness, not write chunk.
native.ua_error_source: Actual receiver oversampling/clock tolerance and worst oscillator uncertainty.
native.ua_observation_source: Actual correlated character/application trace including error status.
native.ua_autobaud_source: Actual completed sync measurement or qualified startup timeout.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application bytes, not encoded UART characters or hardware/API transfer chunk. Framing, parity/start/stop and electrical path remain separate, no65535 global cap.

scope: Every exported UART field individually reviewed. Own clock/framing/peer/FIFO/flow/electrical qualification, industry neutral, no generic115200/CAN/gateway fallback.

Distinct identified PIC24H and LPC24xx framing/reset/divider profiles; fractionally occupied stop time, parity overhead and actual baud from real peripheral clock verified. Reset5bit versus8bit framing are conditional suggestions only.
